reviews.text: Toby has been well cared for by Dr. Donofrio and her staff. Everyone is friendly and the waits are not long. Highly recommend them
We love One Love. Dr. Matos is great. We have been coming here for two years. Since Jesse was a puppy/baby. It’s a wonderful caring place. We recommend it highly.
One love help me and Kasier deal very hard issues. They were Kind, understand and helpful in dealing with end of life issues.
Dr Matos is always so lovely and knowledgeable.  The front staff is welcoming and patient. The vet techs are so gentle with my babies. Definitely recommend one love bay ridge

I’ve been coming here for a few years, and they always provide exceptional care for my dog! The vet office is always clean, and it is not cramped (which is a plus for my anxious dog! She loves her own space). The vets, vet techs, and receptionists all do their best to make every client feel safe and taken care of. They are knowledgeable, and they always work around each pet’s needs.
It is a beautiful hospital for animals they treat them with a lot of love and affection highly recommended this place to bring your pet that you love so much

At One Love Animal Hospital they are extremely attentive, gentle, and caring towards our dog. He’s somewhat shy and they do a great job making him feel comfortable and safe. They are also great communicators and take time to make sure you understand everything that they’re sharing with you.
Very caring.

Great visit for our Bella. We went to get blood work done to make sure she’s ok prior to going under anesthesia for a dental procedure and spaying her, and I can’t say enough good things about Dr. Matos and the technician Alex! Both were so gentle with our Bella and took the time to answer our questions, and the vet was very thorough with explanations that gave us so much peace of mind. Excellent service and would definitely recommend these two lovely individuals.
I arrived earlier than scheduled and was seen right away. Staff was extremely helpful and thorough throughout entire visit.

The receptionists, assistant and doctor were very friendly and compassionate. Given the circumstances I was there under, the place made me feel incredibly comfortable and at ease. I really appreciated how welcoming and understanding everyone was. I’m happy my dog was in great hands.
Seamus has been coming here for a while. He always gets great treatment. All of the people here are very friendly and love animals.
Dr. Zafarnia and the One Love Team are patient and caring. They go over your pets' options and their rationale. You can tell each staff member cares about your pet as if they were their pet.

Our senior cat has been coming here for about 3 years now and every time we leave we are filled with relief. Every staff member has been super helpful & kind. We love One Love and will not bring our baby anywhere else.

I went in with my sick dog yesterday. They were kind & accommodating. After being sick for 9 days he woke up the next day feeling much better! I can’t thank them enough for helping him. I usually overspend at vet offices without any solution but this vet knew what he needed & was not pressuring me to spend more.

I’ve been taking my fur babies to One Love for years. This was after we had tried a few other vets in the area. They are a great location. They do a great job giving your pet the attention they need.

They are also very good at email communication and very willing to help!
Vet was very nice and took time to explain everything to me. Also got clear explanation of pricing

Excellent service, all the staff are very friendly, and they took great care of my pet.
A very clean and pleasant place. I recommend it.
Warm friendly staff. Amazing doctors to take care of my dog. Milo just loves Dr. Matos ♥️
Very exceptional care from staff! Definitely reassure a pet parent with good explanations. Able to come and be at ease when my fur baby is ill. Glad I made the switch from my old vet to one love!
The best there is!
Very attentive and professional care for my dod.
I love one love animal hospital . The care is amazing

The best animal hospital there is.  I have a hard to handle dog, Dr. D'Onofrio Is amazing with him.  She saved his life, after he decided to swallow a rock 11 years ago!  She is all about the animals, and is brilliant.  Her assistants and staff all really care.  I feel comfortable bringing my pet to them. There is no other place I'd go to.
Love all the vets and service .

As a new puppy owner, I want to be able to entrust his care to people who enjoy their profession. Dr. Sokol radiates joy, skill and gentleness as she examines my precious one. She takes the time to explain the what's and why's of her exam and I feel free to call the office if I have any questions or concerns. The staff is a genuinely happy group...maybe it's because they get to see all of the beautiful pets! Dr. Sokol's assistants, Will, on my first visit and Jenna on my second, were warm and knowledgeable and answered my list of questions. The lovely receptionists, in addition to confirming my scheduled appointments, followed-up on how puppy was doing after a vaccination. One Love is a Bay Ridge gem.

I’ve been taking my 5 year old French Bulldog to One Love Animal Hospital Bay Ridge since he was a puppy. And I am also been taking my 18 month old bull terrier too. The vets are very friendly, knowledgeable, and gentle with handling both my pups.

All

The whole entire office was as sweet as can be with us and our Guinea Pig Gabi.  They were gentle with her and are taking exceptional care of her

We have been taking our very senior cat here for the past 3 years after being told she was “too old” to get teeth extraction at another vet. She has been seen by every doctor here due to thyroid and kidney issues, and they have all been AMAZING. Every dr has eased our stressors and we left feeling so relieved every time.
The level of care and attention is incredible here and we are so thankful that we found one love.
Beautiful clean office. Kind gentle staff. Highly recommend.
Love this place and love Dr. D’Onofrio and love all the staff. I highly recommend it.
Great experience at One Love Animal Hospital! The staff is caring, friendly, and professional. They truly care about the animals they treat. Highly recommend!
The team is professional, caring, kind and nice. My Guinea pigs loves them
Staff are kind and caring, particularly thoughtful about making sure your pet is comfortable before they examine or interact with them. They have been treating all three of our dogs!
Amazing doctors and great staff !

I’ve been bringing my cat to this clinic for a few years now, and I couldn’t be happier with the care he receives. All of the doctors and assistants are incredibly kind, caring, and attentive. I always feel confident leaving my cat in their hands and know he is being well cared for. Highly recommend this clinic!

Initially I was receiving very poor service from this clinic - people were often not answering the phone, I was not having messages returned in a timely manner, and there was a miscommunication regarding what kind of prescription food I should give my cat.  I just did not feel like the after-care following my visit was very good at all. I have upgraded my review from one star to three because two of the clinic managers were really great about addressing the issues I was having and they said service will improve at the Bay Ridge clinic.  I am optimistic about things getting better because it is a beautiful, clean facility and close to my home so I would like to continue to take my cat there.  I will re-visit this review after my next visit.
Friendly and inviting office!
My cat Betty has had chronic UTI’s that Dr Matos has helped control.  The staff is so kind and I highly recommend  Dr Matos for your pets care.  She is smart, kind and patient.

This is my second time at this vet, and they are amazing. The techs always greet you with a smile on their faces, the front desk is efficient and quick and the doctors explain what they are doing and why. The care plan for your pet is really a team effort and I felt reassured throughout the experience. Also amazing that I get seen within 10 minutes of being checked in.

Great veterinary office with great staff, from the moment we met, Dr. Matos was incredibly kind, patient, and genuinely caring toward my pet, Cam. What stood out to me most was how much personal interest she took in Cam’s health and well-being. You can tell that Dr. Matos truly loves what she does and cares about the animals she treats. Her compassion and attention to detail gave me a lot of reassurance, and I’m extremely grateful for the way she treated Cam. Cam is lucky to have her looking after her, and I’m grateful we found such a wonderful vet!
Good service overall, they took a while to attend to us but that's all.
We love bringing our dog here. He receives the best care from the staff!
Kind and knowledgeable, we’ve been going there for years with great service!

One Love is my go to. They are the only ones I trust with my cats- they always take the time to explain clearly and genuinely care about my cats comfort. I always feel completely confident that my cats are in great hands. <3
reception was very helpful and the vet was very compassionate and gave us plenty of suggestions for our cat Moon Pie's care. one of the best vets i've ever been to!
Brought in my cat Lucy and they were great! Would recommend for any pet parent.
Doctors and staff are wonderful! I always know my dog is in great hands!

I had a great experience here today! The vet and
Tech were both friendly, caring, and professional, and made both me and my cat feel comfortable. I really appreciated how attentive they were and how well they took care of my cat. Highly recommend this clinic!

Highly recommend One Love as a vet! I’ve been bringing my pets here for over 10 years - both dog and cat. My dog has had his neutering and vaccines here.

We usually see Dr. Matos and Dr. Brian. Both incredibly friendly, very knowledgeable and open on their recommendations on what would be best for your pet.
I’ve been taking my cat to one love for several years, especially now that she’s getting older and has more issues… They are the most caring, professional, and kind people I’ve ever dealt with.
A caring group!
Always a great experience!! All the doctors are very calming and reassuring.
Been coming here since my dog was 8 weeks old, great place and staff
I’ve been bringing my dog to One Love for almost 3 years. The care is also exceptional and everyone is so kind and professional. So lucky to have such an amazing animal hospital in the area!!!
Love them! We have been coming here since 2024, they are gentle and so friendly. Our doggie is so nervous so it we love that they so caring and patient.

Dr Matos takes amazing care of our fur baby. She always follows up even on the occasions we needed to see One Love unexpectedly. All the staff and doctors are amazing as well. It puts us such at ease having them!!
All the staff are so nice
I have been bringing my pets here for a few years now. Staff is incredibly sweet and through. I know I can always count on good care for my babies
My pets are treated so well here, the doctors go above and beyond and are all so informative and knowledgeable. The techs and reception are amazing and so welcoming.

Dr D'Onofrio is great. She cares and works very hard. All my pets go here . They take good care of my dogs. Really care and only do what’s best for them.  From reception to seeing the doctor, Dr D’Onofrio and Kristen, they  are just the best. Thank you so much for taking care of Howard and Bailey.
Love it.
All the staff is super gentle
Love Love Love One Love Animal Hospital! The front desk is always so nice and Dr. Stephanie is the best!

They took care of my baby biscuit above and beyond. They took me as soon as we walked in. Biscuits tech was Alejandro. He is the sweetest and caring person. He taught  us how to hold our dog properly to administer his eye medication. Our vet also went above and beyond . She gave us everything we needed to ensure he will get better.  He eyes are looking better and it’s only the day after. Please bring your fur babies here. Don’t hesitate. They are punctual, informative and efficient.

I love this place! My cat was treated very well, they were very understanding of my concerns and answered all my questions! The front desk ladies are so nice! They make the place feel very welcoming! I’m so grateful to everyone there for making me feel comfortable and reassured me that my cat was in great hands!💕
Shout out to Sandy, Darla & Ariella! These lovely ladies set a caring, friendly, and  helpful tone for the practice. Kudos 😘 …

1) don’t like that they take my animal away and I am not in the room; 2) got there for an appointment on time, having made the appointment in advance and they didn’t have the medication I specifically was there for; and they didn’t bother to call. 3) I got the notice that it was time for a procedure… that they can’t schedule.

My first time going to One Love Hospital was the best. So clean, everyone so nice. The doctor was wonderful and explained everything in detail. Very spacious. Best decision I made to bring my dog there. I highly recommend them.
They help you in any way . They are honest loving and caring . It's just a A+place
It's the best veterinary service I've ever gotten. A breath of fresh air coming from private and unprofessional veterinarians. The staff is amazing 😍 Shot out to Orian!

Kyle was wonderful. It was a pleasure to deal with him.

Both Kyle and Dr. D’Onofrio were very courteous and kind and took care of my cat extremely well.

Dr. D'Ofrio and her vet tech were very on point and answered all questions

everyone was professional, polite and a pleasure to work with.
Everyone was caring, kind and helpful.

Unfortunately I wanted to leave 0 stars but a review was needed. THIS COMES WITH A WARNING LABEL: DO NOT BRING YOUR ANIMALS HERE! Upon entering the lobby there is a reception area. You can already feel the negative energy all around. There are mainly two people sometimes three at the front desk. These people show no compassion, are extremely rude and snippy. You would think that working at an animal hospital there would be kindness and empathy...there is none here. They just sit there and don't even ask how your animal is or if the owner is ok. They laugh behind the desk when spoken to and show unprofessionalism for customers that come in. The front desk are not meant for this type of environment. The manager there, her name is Jenn, she is a horrible supervisor. She has no empathy and doesn't care about the animals and people just like the front desk. There are many scenarios, but one time my dog was brought out from the examination room and was so scared and petrified when he came out. There were other dogs barking like crazy inside, it was disturbing. I was thinking :"this is a place where you are supposed to care for animals." It is the complete opposite. All they care about is money and ripping customers off so they can add more charges to the bill. I have already started and continued a word of mouth in the neighborhood not to bring their animals here. Someone wanted to bring their dog here to get spayed and I spoke about my experience and they WILL NOT BE GOING HERE. If you care about your animals think before you open the door. There is no love here at this hospital, there is cruelness and disrespect!

Took our cat for an exam and had a great experience from beginning to end!
Really nice large waiting area with cookies and coffee :)
Receptionist Darlissea is thorough and sweet. She explained the payments and charges, worked around our availability, and managed complex records. We walked in and hardly had to wait at all.
Vet tech Kristin is warm and smart. Asked good questions, was patient, and helped our cat hold still for the exam.
And Dr Laura D’Onofrio is the cream of the crop. She provided excellent care, explained everything carefully, is very logical, and is kind but firm about her recommendations. I could see how experienced she was when she was examining our cat’s neck and abdomen.
This clinic goes above and beyond and I would trust them completely! I thought pricing was more than fair for this dream team.
Over priced and misdiagnosed.

$1800 to tell us our cat was dying .
Went to another vet that took blood .$75
Said cat was fine
2 years later , Cats doing great . They won’t sell us our cats monthly food because she’s no longer a patient.

Very nice veterinarian office which has a pretty large waiting room to avoid pet-on-pet complications; you still have to be careful near the door if you have a wild one (we do).

The veternarian and staff are nice and concise and the available options regarding vaccinations and other treatments are presented to you beforehand. This is nice because you can review which are the necessities and which are just nice-to-have (e.g. I don't take my dog in the woods so I'll just roll the dice on the tick prevention and save $150). Everything is pretty expensive but I'm going to chalk that up to the rising price of pretty much everything (plus it's New York) so its not a specific negative. There were no issues regarding the treatment of my pets, and they can be pretty crazy, so thats a positive for the staff.

Overall a very nice establishment and the personnel are professional and pleasant so we will be coming back (if they let us).

Dr.Pavel and vet tech Alex was very helpful and professional treating my GSD (Zio). I would recommend this clinic and doctors mentioned.
Also prices are ok.

Unfortunately this place has changed.  Their new young male vet tech is very unprofessional and discourteous.  I was going to this location since 2017.  When i was dealing Vet tech Dononfrio , she was amazing and professional. This new male vet tech needs to take lessons about customer service.  I will gladly take my dog to a different vet. And give them the Business.  One love in bay ridge needs a serious management/ tech change.

Used to be good, but their new vet tech knows nothing of customer service - they even went so far as to threaten me by saying the "phone call is being recorded" after I questioned their statements. Nothing to hide and told them sure go ahead and review the call, but wow what a tactic!  - Note that any good business will inform their customers that calls are being recorded at the beginning of the call not in the middle. What happened to this place ? Oh and they called me not the other way around so to say you are being recorded after you call a customer is serious breach of trust, privacy and customer service. I have spent thousands and thousands of $ on my pets with them, and the Dr's I dealt with were fantastic, but I will NEVER go to a place that calls customers to record their conversations as per their tech! Beware.

Most unprofessional spot ever, never again. They charge you 360 for a check up, and don’t even do a proper checkup, so I thought I’d mentioned it on the spot. I Brought my dog in again a few months after (thinking it wouldn’t happen again) and since I addressed them about the “good job” they do, they won’t help my dog. I’m just saying instead of being mad at the customer? Do a better job.

Great hospital. I have four cats. Every time I bring them for check up or anything else I experience the best communication, treat, service. Highly recommend.
The best in Bay ridge.
I took my cat Simon to the facility as an emergency, the staff and Doctor were all so kind and compassionate. A big thank you to One Love!

We found a friendly dog wandering around our block and brought her here to see if she had a microchip. The front desk was super helpful and wrote down all the info they could find and even tried the number for us. We were able to find the owner via the address. Thank you so much!

This is a wonderful practice. Dr. Zafarnia and Alejandro are fantastic professionals. It's so fortunate to have a place like this right here in the neighborhood.

Dr. Z and Alejandro have been able to administer exams and shots to my very fractious senior cat without general anesthesia while other practices have insisted she needed it for routine exams. And with exceptional bedside manner. Vets in the past have not shown such grace (putting it mildly), which made me disinclined to bring her in routinely. But knowing they have the expertise to handle such a spicy senior kitty without the risk of general anesthesia, we'll be getting her regular check-ups here.

They've also been supremely helpful in navigating my younger cat's behavioral issues. Their knowledge, professionalism, and empathy exceed expectations. They offer an incredibly comprehensive treatment plan, which I very much appreciate. They go over all potential costs and charges in detail and answer questions thoughtfully and transparently.

The cost of the initial estimate with every recommendation can look high, but there's no pressure to do all of it and in the end, I find it very reasonable for the level of service provided. The costs have been lower than another place in Brooklyn 5 years ago, not even accounting for the astronomical inflation since. (A place I was dissatisfied with.)

Pretty sure I've never written a review this long, but I really love this vet office and they have vastly improved my cats,' and therefore my, quality of life. Alejandro and Dr. Zafarnia are amazing, but I'm sure everyone here is great. They really love animals, and your animals will get the best care here.

Always a pleasure, always positive. Nice people. That was from 4 yrs ago. Still nice people. The update 4 yrs later you find that Hospital is not in what they do. I have an active dog. I was turned away twice in an emergency. This last time 15 min hold on the phone, to be told nope no here today. Then to have the manager say sorry not sorry the next day. Horrible. If you can't plan your emergencies don't go here. Find a vet who acts like your Dr. would. If your animal is active like my happy pup go somewhere else they will let you down. There are plenty in Brooklyn.
get a prescription and order your pets meds off chewy.

My geriatric dog got very sick very suddenly on a weekend and One Love agreed to see her which was amazing in itself because most places do not have same day appointments. The vet was very kind and understanding and unfortunately it seemed that our dog was on her last legs and we had to make the painful decision to put her to sleep. None of us were mentally or emotionally prepared at all. We were all a mess. The vet was amazingly patient and though we were too distraught to observe social niceties, she was not annoyed at all and continued to be professional yet deeply empathetic. People say this place isn't the cheapest but trust me, they are worth every penny and then some. When you and your family are overwhelmed by grief, you will appreciate a great place like this. This is not the first time we had to put a beloved pet to sleep. When our prior dog got cancer and had to be put to sleep, we went to a different establishment and had a far different experience -- the vet was cold, aloof, and uncaring, and that really makes a bad situation only feel worse and more traumatizing. It's not worth the paltry savings. Just go to One Love.
Wonderful, caring staff.

Affordable. Quick. Clean. Convenient.

Bonus: They care. Definitely going again.

I write with with a heavy heart.. my dog started scratching at his ears so I brought him to one love. They told me his ears were clean and that there was nothing wrong with him but said it was "allergies" so I brought him home and tried to comfort him. This continued for about 6 months where I brought him in a couple more times only for them to tell me his ears are clean and suggested giving him meds for allergies, so I did under their request. Not once did they suggest it could be something else more serious. Im so uneducated to not realize it was his brain and not his ears. He was scratching at his ears because his head hurt and I didnt understand that because of the suggestion they told me it was allergies. I blame myself for not realizing it and bringing him to one love. I live with that pain everyday. Imagine a doctor who went to school to treat animals not understanding that it could have been something other than allergies and just saying "its allergies" everytime I brought him in. And not suggesting to get it looked at more. We trust the doctors words and guidance because we dont know any better. I trusted them.. Little did I know it was a tumor growing. Until he started having seizures and I rushed him to the hospital did the other vet tell me what it was. Its my fault. I blame myself for not realizing something so obvious. Looking back it was so obvious. They made me feel as though it really was allergies. I feel tricked and so uneducated. I regret not going somewhere else. I regret taking their word for it. Looking back it was so obvious it could have been his brain but they didnt even suggest that? They just had me coming back for "allergy" meds and making money off me. Telling me its allergies..... this whole time. I feel so sad and upset listening to them. On his final days when I brought him back because his back legs were shaking and he couldnt walk, they told me he just hurt his back.... and suggested I get an mri to check if it was a slipped disc.... So my dogs back legs were shaking, hes completely disassociated..... and theyre telling me "its just his back" not even suggesting it can be something more serious, right then and there my heart dropped to my stomach... I completely ignored what they said and brought him to an emergency hospital immediately because I finally realized the doctor had no clue what they were talking about. And I was right. When I brought him to the hospital they told me it was a tumor in his brain. I couldnt believe I was bringing my dog to a vet who I thought was competent. I should have listened to myself earlier and trusted myself rather than taking the words of people who really and factually had no clue what was going on. Not once did they realize or suggest "hey it might not be his ears"... Just "its allergies, we can prescribe his allergy meds" imagine that. They are kind people, I genuinely think they were trying to help, thats why I felt comfort in their words and trusted them in saying its allergies. Im not taking away from their kindness or hospitality. Sometimes even vets have absolutely no clue what they are talking about and its up to you to get a second opinion. I didnt get a second opinion because it trusted theirs. And after paying thousands of dollars, for some people its tough to go to another place. The bottom line and the truth is, they were incompetent. Six months ago if they told me "hey since his ears are clean and he keeps scratching at this head maybe its something else BESIDES ALLERGIES" maybe I would have been able to do something and maybe even help prevent the tumor from growing more. Its my fault for trusting and listening to their words. I hope they learn to be better and really look into things rather than guessing. The vet techs are good people and this isnt their fault. Its mine.

As others have stated, this place is very expensive. They also lack communication and transparency, causing me unnecessary costs. The vets are nice but they have lost me as a client and provided a disappointing, expensive experience that will also require me to push back a procedure my pet needs due to their unprofessionalism.

A little expensive but dedicated and caring service. I felt understood by the vet and the vet tech and had all of my dog's needs met in one visit (which was huge considering we weren't 100% sure what the issue was). Also, they tell you costs up front and work with you on prioritizing the most expensive tests. Really great service.
Great vet with a dedicated staff of doctors and tech. Excellent service highly recommend
Very attentive and friendly staff.  All the vets are very kind and professional.

This place will charge you an unbelievable amount of money for very average services and inconsistent hours (they’ve closed early with no warning or reason on multiple occasions where I’ve tried to come into the office). As well, only ONE vet here was ever receptive of our complaints about the fact that our pet was still getting worse with treatment. In fact, our pet didn’t get better until this one vet collaborated with us to create a new plan to help our pet. Unless you have a very specific reason to come here, I’d say go somewhere else. Whoever owns this place is definitely sending out a message that they’re only in it for your money.
Really great staff

Slightly pricey for the area but we love the vets here. Dr. Matos has taken great care of our dogs and cat, and she’s always very patient and understanding with us and our shy animals. I only wish they had an online appointment booking system!
Always a money grab.

Where to begin? This is the best animal medical center in my experience, my son Eddie is having issues and the caring professional care he received was unsurpassed, the doctors are awesome and the entire team is extremely caring and helpful but most of all very supportive, we never want our furry babies to get ill, but when they do we like them to be in the best possible hands available and Eddie and I were referred to this awesome place by our loving Barbara and Husband Andrew, they bring their friend Kelly there, She’s a Beautiful pug and Eddie’s Best Friend, I highly recommend One Love Animal Hospital to everyone, there is no safer place to be. Thank You Very Much For Attending to my son Eddie, We Totally Appreciate You 💯% Respectfully: Marc Martinez
Best Vet. Very professional and courteous. Take their time to answer questions.

They only care about your money and not your pet. I brought my 2 month old kitten here with ringworm and they gave me a topical treatment for him, as it was only on his face at the time. It got so much worse within a week and spread all …

I would give zero stars if I could. This place is greedy business that only rips money from you! Customer service is horrible they made up extra “fees” and their deposit full-service money for an appointment. Never go there.

worst , just trying to take away more of your money . I dont think they care about your pet.   Also absolutely uncomfortable cos they take your pet away for vaccine and you dont know what they do with it .

Went here for three years for regular checkups for my dog. I would say service was fine. They did what was needed. However, they are incredibly expensive. I shouldn’t have to pay close to $1k for vaccines, checkups, etc. Each time I went it …

The office staff are so professional.
They are warm and welcoming.
They answer my questions and help me with finding pet insurance. …
We've been bringing our pups here for years. The vets and staff are reliable and friendly, the space is great, and they've taken excellent care of our dogs.

I have been coming to One Love Animal Hospital for many years and have been consistently impressed with the level of professionalism, care and compassion my cats have been given. The office is so unique and welcoming. The staff is friendly …
Great place and great people. The vets, the techs and the reception staff are all kind and knowledgeable. They are so good with my cats. Highly recommend one love.
Highly recommended! All the stuff is very friendly and helpful!

Been a client of one love veterinarian animal Hospital Bay Ridge Brooklyn since day, one of them opening- I wouldn’t go anywhere else! They have cared for all my fur babies . And now my gentle giant Salem. British blue . had called  early …
